question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

Raghu cannot decide whether to divorce his wife or not. He is at **a point in life where his decisions will have long term consequences. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"at a crossroads"** means being in a situation where an important decision must be made, which will have significant consequences. (ऐसी स्थिति जहां महत्वपूर्ण निर्णय लेना हो)

 
 
• **Example:** She found herself at a crossroads in her career and had to choose between staying in her current job or accepting a new offer.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spill the beans** (रहस्य प्रकट कर देना): Reveal secret information unintentionally or indiscreetly.

 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Make No Bones About** (बिना किसी संकोच के कहना): State a fact or opinion confidently and without hesitation.
 
 
• **Example:** She made no bones about her disappointment in the team's performance.
 
 
 
• **Tongue And Cheek** (हास्यपूर्ण या गैर गंभीर तरीके से कहा गया): Said or done in a humorous or not serious way.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments were meant to be tongue and cheek, but some people took them seriously.
 
 

39:Tb7f,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
